answer_1.quote: In this paper, we present OG-RAG (Ontology-Grounded Retrieval Augmented Generation), which enhances LLMs by integrating domain-specific ontologies for fact-based adaptation.
datasets: news domain dataset from Multi-hop RAG

answer_2.quote: Building on the RAGAS framework (RAGAS, 2024), we use the following metrics to assess the quality of the retrieved context and the generated responses...

answer_3.quote: We make two additional LLM calls to generate the corresponding answer and assign a rating from 1 to 10, evaluating how well the question tests the application of the rules on the data to derive the answer.
methods: rating from 1 to 10 on rule application
criteria: how well the question tests the application of the rules on the data

answer_4.quote: We recruited a total of 16 participants, aged 18-34, and familiar with LLMs within a university campus after approving their consent.
answer_4.guideline: Participants are asked to evaluate the level of factual support the context provides for the response on a scale of 1-4, where 1 corresponds to 'no support' and 4 corresponds to 'full support' for all claims. We also track the time each participant takes to complete this task.
